responsibility: Implements a pluggable Caesar-cipher filter for gm2 channels by saving a channel’s existing DeviceTable hooks and replacing them with wrapped text and raw read/write operations. It stores per-channel cipher state through RTdata, encrypts and decrypts characters and LOC values on the fly, decorates device names, restores original hooks when removed, and raises notAvailable diagnostics for unsupported LOC sizes or duplicate layer insertion, thereby demonstrating the extensibility of the IOChan/IOLink device stack.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file differs from SimpleCipher.def by implementing the channel filter layer itself: it saves and replaces DeviceTable operations, tracks cipher metadata with RTdata, and performs Caesar encryption/decryption during channel reads and writes.
